contract: Library media drawer Provider history: let a collection operator visually compare current and observed covers, approve the exact credential-safe candidate, confirm the exact apply plan, and understand immutable before/after history. Keep a quiet scannable hierarchy—comparison, review, preview, confirmation, history—using existing CollectZ controls. Paired portrait cover wells must distinguish every state without showing proxy paths; missing and failed images need safe text. Support 390x844 and 1440x900 with long titles.

accessibility.evidence: Playwright located the comparison by visible labels and image alternative text, and exercised review, preview, confirmation, cancel/apply button semantics. Rendered inspection confirmed readable labels and no color-only status dependency.

responsive.evidence: Rendered 390x844 and 1440x900 captures show the paired 2:3 cover wells, confirmation copy, and actions contained by the drawer without overlap or horizontal overflow.

loading.evidence: The browser flow exercised provider-history, review, preview, and apply transitions; existing loading labels and disabled actions retained stable drawer structure.

empty.evidence: The browser regression rendered and asserted the explicit No cover set state for an absent current cover.

error.evidence: The browser regression forced the observed proxy request to return 404 and asserted the Cover unavailable recovery state.

partial.evidence: The drawer remained usable with a missing current cover and failed observed cover while preserving review context and safe labels.

success.evidence: The browser regression completed approval, exact preview confirmation, apply, and asserted Previous cover and Applied cover history.

permission.reason: The Provider history surface is not mounted for an out-of-scope media record; exact-library authorization returns non-disclosing not-found before this drawer state exists.

renderedEvidence.observation: Desktop drawer shows the approved cover plan as two clearly labeled portrait wells, eligibility, preserve-only explanation, and separated confirmation actions.
Mobile drawer keeps the long title, paired current/proposed covers, eligibility, confirmation copy, and touch actions within the viewport without overlap.
